name: San Diego
tagline: Beaches, Balboa Park and endless sunshine
summary: California's sunniest big city, with 110 km of beaches, the gardens and museums of Balboa Park, one of the world's best zoos, sea lions at La Jolla and fish tacos everywhere.
seasonNote: Mild all year. 'May gray' and 'June gloom' bring cloudy mornings; July to September is warmest and busiest.
arrival: San Diego International Airport is 10 minutes from Downtown; Amtrak's Pacific Surfliner runs along the coast from Los Angeles.
gettingAround: The trolley covers Downtown, Old Town and the border; rent a car or bike for the beaches.
foodTip: Fish tacos, California burritos, craft beer and Mexican food in Old Town and Barrio Logan.
baseArea: Gaslamp Quarter or Little Italy for the city; La Jolla or Pacific Beach for the coast

connections.note: Amtrak Pacific Surfliner along the coast.
